facts.business: Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited is an integrated steel manufacturer with captive iron ore mines, producing alloy steel, pellets, sponge iron (DRI), pig iron, and automotive, construction, and engineering castings.

capacity_or_capex.item: Chhotedongar Iron Ore Mine capacity enhancement

auditor.name: M/s. R.A. Daga & Co., Company Secretaries (Secretarial Auditor); M/s. Manisha & Associates, Cost Accountants (Cost Auditor); M/s. Agrawal Chhallani & Co., Chartered Accountants (Tax Auditor)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding attachment of properties worth Rs 30,758.39 Lakhs by the Directorate of Enforcement (ED); the PMLA Appellate Tribunal set aside the provisional attachments and the Special Court discharged the Company under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act; ED has challenged the CBI Court order in the Supreme Court.

key_risks: Inventory valuation risk due to significance of inventories balance (23.37% of total assets) and complexities in determining cost across integrated manufacturing process, multiple locations, and obsolete inventories
Legal and regulatory risk from ED attachment of properties and ongoing litigation in Supreme Court
